title: Cuban Missile Crisis
summary: Soviet missiles in Cuba bring the United States and USSR to the edge of nuclear war.
body: A naval “quarantine,” secret Turkey-missile bargaining, and luck all featured. Crisis management became a Cold War skill and a myth. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Allison and Zelikow, Essence of Decision
Fursenko and Naftali, One Hell of a Gamble
